_source: SIMULATED - every field here is invented and none of it comes from the sandbox
_why: A situation is a problem the system spotted, with its cause and a proposed fix. Producing these for real needs workflow work items and their error status (SWWWIHEAD), the approver substitution table (HRUS_D2), change documents (CDHDR / CDPOS) and blocked invoice data. The sandbox exposes none of that. Everything in this file is a plausible demo, so never present it to a customer as live data.

_fields.severity: high or medium, drives the colour on screen
_fields.canAutoFix: whether the fix is safe and reversible enough for the system to apply it once the manager confirms
_fields.detectedAt: clock time of this morning's run

situations.title: Approver away with no stand-in
situations.detail: S. Kulkarni has been marked away since 2 September. The approval for order 4500178342 has no stand-in, so it cannot move at all.
situations.cause: No stand-in was recorded for this approver before the absence started.
situations.proposedFix: Name the recorded deputy A. Deshmukh as stand-in and send the approval to them.

situations.title: Approval failed to reach anyone
situations.detail: The approval for request 1000442190 failed because the system could not work out who owns the cost centre it should go to.
situations.cause: No owner is recorded against cost centre 4100, so there was nobody to send it to.
situations.proposedFix: Read the owner from the cost centre record and restart the approval.

situations.title: Stock runs out before the delivery can arrive
situations.detail: Gypsum at Sirohi has 4.5 days of cover against a 12 day lead time and nothing on order. Kiln feed stops before a replacement delivery could reach the plant.
situations.cause: A spike in consumption meant the reorder point was not reached at the last planning run.
situations.proposedFix: Raise a request for 4,400 MT with Shreeji Minerals and mark it for same-day approval.

situations.title: Supplier deliveries getting steadily later
situations.detail: Aditya Refractories has slipped from under a day late to eleven days late across the last ten orders, and is charging 6.3 percent above the contract rate.
situations.cause: Trend across the supplier's last ten orders, not a single bad delivery.
situations.proposedFix: Attach the performance summary to order 4500178401 before approving and ask for a firm revised delivery date.

situations.title: Order value raised after it was approved
situations.detail: Order 4500178120 was increased by 12 percent after approval, and the approval rules were not applied again to the new value.
situations.cause: The change history shows the value was edited after the approval was recorded.
situations.proposedFix: Withdraw the approval and send the order through the approval rules again at its new value.

situations.title: Invoice blocked on a price difference
situations.detail: An invoice from Aditya Refractories has been blocked for 12 days over a 6.4 percent price difference against the order.
situations.cause: Invoice price of 43,800 per MT against an order price of 41,200 per MT.
situations.proposedFix: Send it to the buyer with the contract rate and the last three invoice prices attached.
